purpose: Input checklist only. Replace with same-scene measured evidence before merging into planar_calibration.
image_coordinate_system: Undistorted cropped source pixels, not resized display screenshots. K must use this same coordinate system.
world_coordinate_system: Surveyed road plane Z=0; metres; X lateral, Y longitudinal. Record origin and handedness.
distortion_note: Zero here is the rectified-input contract, not a claim that the original lens has zero distortion.
requirements: At least 6 control pairs across all lanes and near/far depths
Never create check points by applying the fitted homography
Attach independently surveyed lane polylines and measurement uncertainty
